title: The 5 Tallest Dams Ever Built, Ranked (#1 Is 305 Meters Tall)

scenes.text: The five tallest dams ever built, ranked. The top one is taller than most skyscrapers.

scenes.label: Baihetan · 289 m
scenes.text: Number five: Baihetan Dam in China. Two hundred and eighty-nine meters of concrete across the Jinsha River.

scenes.label: Xiaowan · 292 m
scenes.text: Number four: Xiaowan Dam, also in China. Two hundred and ninety-two meters tall, an arch of solid concrete.

scenes.label: Lianghekou · 295 m
scenes.text: Number three: Lianghekou Dam, China again. Two hundred and ninety-five meters of rock and concrete.

scenes.label: Nurek · 300 m
scenes.text: Number two: Nurek Dam in Tajikistan. Three hundred meters tall, built from earth and rock, not concrete.

scenes.label: Jinping-I · 305 m
scenes.text: Number one: Jinping-I Dam in China. Three hundred and five meters, as tall as a hundred-story skyscraper.

description:
The five tallest dams ever built, ranked by height.
Jinping-I in China stands 305 meters tall, and all five of the top five are in Asia.
What should we rank next?
first_comment: Which dam would you want to stand on top of? And what should we rank next?
